attacks.name: Telekinetic Katana
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!energy| or |!mystic|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Neural Disruption|: Before |!damage| is dealt, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender loses 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Psi-Bow
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Psionic Assault
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Combat Enhancement
superPowers.body: This character may immediately Advance |!range_small|. The next time it makes a |*Telekinetic Katana| attack this Turn, add 2 dice to the attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Precognition
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, this character may reroll 1 of its attack or defense dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
